children.label: 1. Card Unlock
children.body: Cards are now unlocked. Move cards freely between your Hand and Spread before taking other Winter actions.

children.label: 2. Offering to the Age (optional)
children.body: The Agekeeper convenes all Alchemists to make a collective Offering. Contribute cards sharing at least one Aspect with the Cosmic Age. If the group's combined Rank Points meet the threshold, every contributor earns a Cauldron Catalyst — a 2-for-1 Reagent Crafting boost for the full following round.

children.label: 3. Fateful Wager (optional)
children.body: Bet cards on a prediction: which Zodiac Sign will rule the next Cosmic Age. Guess correctly and your wager is doubled. Guess wrong and it is lost to the Fates. Wagers resolve at the start of next Spring.

children.label: 4. Enforce Card Limits
children.body: Discard down to card limits before the next Age: Spread 7 cards · Hand 5 cards · Arcanum: Adept cards only (discard all Fate Major Arcana to the Common Deck).

children.label: 5. Transit the Age
children.body: The Agekeeper collects all discarded Kismeta Cards, shuffles the Common Deck, and taps it twice to cleanse it. Then pass the Agekeeper's Key clockwise to the next player. Return to Phase 1: Spring.
